dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Hey, pal, do you know the way to Narukami Island?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Everyone calls me Master Qin. You can go with that name.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: I'm a martial artist from Liyue hired by the Communications Office. Right now, I'm working as a bodyguard for a merchant called Li Xiao.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: I had wanted to visit Inazuma before. That's why I took this job.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to go to Narukami Island?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Yeah, staying in Ritou is so boring.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: And I have already escorted my employer to Inazuma safely. The job is considered done anyway. Isn't it up to me, then, where I want to go next?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: It's such a rare opportunity. I even passed through that stormy ocean. Why shouldn't I go see the world a bit more?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Since I am here, I have to figure out what it's like to live in Inazuma, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did you come to Inazuma?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Hmm, I heard that the locals excel in swordsmanship, and I wanted to see it for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: I'm not boasting. I've already defeated half of the fighters in Liyue with my unique technique, Rumbling Hand. No one's been a match for me yet!

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: I have not only won the title of Crux Clash Champion, but also clocked the teeth off some of those so-called ace fighters who possess Visions...

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Going undefeated all these years is just too boring! Hmph, so I just want to see the world, challenge fighters everywhere, and learn about foreign cultures.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: If you find a way to get to Narukami Island, don't forget to tell me! I will treat you to Inazuman matcha!

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Why hello there, friend! You look like someone who has a few tricks up their sleeve. How about a few go-arounds with me in the ring?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Everyone calls me Master Qin. You can go with that name.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: I'm a martial artist hired by the Communications Office. Right now, I'm working as a bodyguard for a merchant called Li Xiao.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Go-arounds"?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Why, of course! Not to boast or anything, but I've already defeated half of the fighters in Liyue with my unique technique, Rumbling Hand. No one's been a match for me yet!

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: I have not only won the title of Crux Clash Champion, but also clocked the teeth off some of those so-called ace fighters who possess Visions...

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: I traveled through Inazuma previously. Not a single fighter of note to be found, I tell you! Disappointing, is what it was!

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: That's why I've returned to Liyue recently. I mean, who knows, maybe some new talent has arisen while I away that might be worth a bout or two.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Aye. If you ever want to have a match, I'm ready anytime!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds very adventurous!

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Haha, so you are a member of the Adventurers' Guild?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Hmm, not bad! Now that I've been praised by an adventurer, I'll have to try even harder.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: These are the experiences that I've accumulated in my previous adventures. I'll share them with you.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: If you learn anything new, please tell me!
